stock.description: EC Healthcare, an investment holding firm, delivers an extensive range of medical and healthcare services throughout Hong Kong, Macau, and mainland China. Its operations are structured into three primary divisions: Medical, Aesthetic Medical and Beauty and Wellness, and an 'Others' category. The company's diverse service offerings include quasi-medical treatments, beauty and wellness programs, medical imaging, surgical procedures, aesthetic medicine, dentistry, hair restoration, vaccinations, chiropractic care, psychological support, and orthopedic services. Beyond direct patient care, EC Healthcare also provides administrative and management support, laboratory diagnostics, various marketing and performance marketing solutions, and even travel agency services. Furthermore, it retails beauty and skincare products, manages healthcare machinery, engages in property investment, offers multi-channel networking, and extends its expertise to veterinary services. Its product and service portfolio is primarily marketed under proprietary brands such as PRODERMA LAB, Swissline, Suissebeaute, and re:HEALTH. Established in 2005 and headquartered in Mong Kok, Hong Kong, the company was formerly known as Union Medical Healthcare Limited before rebranding to EC Healthcare in April 2021.
